To deter sellers from abandoning bad identities, hold each order payment in escrow until delivery inspection and a fixed dispute window end. Reserve the full refundable amount per order; resolve valid claims from that reserve before paying the seller. Closing an account or opening aliases cannot release or reuse the held funds.
